# Getting help

| You have | Go to |
|---|---|
| A bug in the `sepay` CLI | [Open an issue](https://github.com/sepayvn/sepay-cli/issues/new/choose) |
| An idea for a command or flag | [Open a feature request](https://github.com/sepayvn/sepay-cli/issues/new/choose) |
| A question about your SePay account, a transaction or the SePay API | support@sepay.vn |
| A question about integrating SePay | [developer.sepay.vn](https://developer.sepay.vn) |
| A security issue | [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), never a public issue |

Before filing a CLI bug, check `sepay help <topic>` and `sepay <command> --help`.
